tool_arguments.query: AWS operating income Q2 2026 Amazon quarterly results

events.content: AWS operating income Q2 2026 Amazon quarterly results

AWS generated **$42.232 billion of net sales (segment revenue)** in Amazon’s Q2 2026, the three months ended June 30, 2026, up 37% from $30.873 billion in Q2 2025. [[1]] 

AWS reported **$16.621 billion of operating income** in Q2 2026, versus $10.160 billion a year earlier; this equates to an operating margin of approximately **39.4%** of AWS revenue. [[2]] [[1]]

tool_arguments.query: AWS AI contribution revenue Q2 2026 Amazon

events.content: AWS AI contribution revenue Q2 2026 Amazon

- **AWS growth:** AWS revenue was **$42.2 billion in Q2 2026**, up **36.7% year over year**—its fastest growth in 18 quarters—and Amazon said the business reached a **$169 billion annualized revenue run rate**. [[1]]

- **AI-revenue disclosure:** Amazon said AWS’s **AI business exceeded a $25 billion annual revenue run rate** and was growing at a **triple-digit year-over-year rate**; this equates to more than **$6.25 billion on a simple quarterly run-rate basis** and at least roughly **15% of AWS’s $169 billion annualized revenue**, although Amazon did not formally disclose quarterly AI revenue or its precise share of AWS growth. [[1]]

- **Management’s key comment on workload contribution:** Andy Jassy said AWS was seeing strong growth in both **AI** and **non-AI (“core”)** workloads, with each supporting the other rather than AI being an isolated revenue stream. [[2]]

- **Mechanism:** Management said AI adoption encourages customers to move to AWS and increases core-service consumption; moreover, post-training reinforcement learning and AI-agent tool use are largely CPU-intensive, benefiting AWS core compute as well as AI accelerators. [[3]]

- **Important caveat:** Therefore, it would be inaccurate to attribute all—or a defined portion—of the 36.7% AWS growth rate to AI: Amazon disclosed rapid AI revenue growth, but **did not quantify AI’s percentage-point contribution** to Q2 AWS growth. [[3, 1]]

Sources:
[S3.1] Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/
[S3.2] Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Q2 FY2026 earnings call transcript — https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/earnings/AMZN-Q2-2026-earnings_call-657334.html
[S3.3] Amazon (AMZN) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/07/amazon-amzn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

events.content: Google Cloud Q2 2026 revenue operating income Alphabet earnings

Amazon’s latest reported quarter is Q2 2026, released July 30, 2026. [[1]]

| AWS metric | Q2 2026 | YoY comparison |
|---|---:|---:|
| Segment revenue | **$42.2 billion** | **+37%** |
| Segment operating income | **$16.6 billion** | $10.2 billion in Q2 2025 |
| Operating margin | **39.4%** | — |
| Annualized revenue run rate | **$169 billion** | — |

AWS revenue was $42.232 billion, up 37% year over year, while AWS operating income was $16.621 billion versus $10.160 billion a year earlier; the implied/reported segment operating margin was 39.4%. [[1]] [[2]]

**AI contribution:** Amazon did not disclose a separate quarterly dollar revenue or operating-profit contribution from AI within AWS. [[1]] However, management said AWS’s AI business exceeded a **$25 billion annual revenue run rate** and was growing at a **triple-digit year-over-year percentage rate**. [[1]] Amazon also said its chips business—which includes its AI-related infrastructure offerings—exceeded a separate **$25 billion annual revenue run rate**, likewise with triple-digit growth. [[1]] 

At the consolidated level, Amazon reported Q2 operating income of **$27.5 billion**, up from $19.2 billion in Q2 2025, meaning AWS generated roughly 60% of company operating income in the quarter. [[1]] [[2]] Net income of $62.6 billion included **$53.4 billion of non-operating pre-tax other income**, primarily related to Amazon’s Anthropic investment, so that gain should not be interpreted as AWS operating performance or recurring AI operating profit. [[1]]

{"summary":"AWS (Q2 2026, three months ended June 30, 2026):
- Segment revenue: $42.232 B, up 37% YoY from $30.873 B in Q2 2025 (S1.1).
- Segment operating income: $16.621 B, up 64% YoY from $10.160 B; operating margin 39.4% (S2.1, S2.2).
- AI contribution: AWS's AI business exceeded a $25 B annual revenue run rate, growing at a triple‑digit YoY rate; Amazon did not disclose a formal quarterly AI‑revenue figure or its percentage‑point contribution to the 37% growth (S3.1).
- Benchmark: Microsoft Azure grew 38% YoY in constant currency in FY26 Q2 (quarter ended Dec 31, 2025), essentially on parity with AWS's 37% YoY growth (S9.1).

Sources cited throughout: S1.1–S9.1 (Amazon earnings releases, earnings‑call transcripts, Microsoft investor release)."}
